tone_read: Calm and declarative; 'Before the metro' is a time-of-day cue and carries no outcome.
language_read: Strength and purity are stated the way the brand does (10% Vitamin C, Ethyl Ascorbic Acid with 86% pure Vitamin C content, 1% Acetyl Glucosamine), all page-backed, and the page's comparison with other Vitamin C derivatives is left out. No efficacy claim is used.
